limits.en: Up to 10 collaborators and 10 boards per Workspace, unlimited cards, 250 Workspace command runs/month, 10 MB/file storage.

keyLimits.en: Unlimited boards, 1,000 automation runs/month, 250 MB/file storage
Unlimited automation runs, Calendar/Timeline/Table/Dashboard/Map views, workspace templates
Unlimited Workspaces, org-wide permissions, SSO via Atlassian Guard, 24/7 admin support

cautions.en: Monthly billing costs more per seat than annual on every paid tier (e.g. Standard $6 monthly vs $5/month billed annually).
The free plan's 250 Workspace-wide automation runs/month is shared across all boards, not per board.

capabilities.en: Visual Kanban boards with cards, lists, unlimited Power-Ups and an activity log for lightweight project tracking.
Built-in automation (Butler) with a monthly run quota that scales by plan.
Multiple views (Calendar, Timeline, Table, Dashboard, Map) available from Premium up, beyond plain Kanban.

limitations.en: Free plan caps at 10 boards and 10 collaborators per Workspace, restrictive for a growing team.
Advanced views (Timeline, Dashboard, Table, Map) and unlimited automation require the Premium tier, not Standard.

reason.en: Broader all-in-one workspace with Kanban as one of several view types.
More structured project/task management for teams outgrowing simple Kanban.
Atlassian's own heavier alternative for software teams needing agile workflows.
